name: cancelOrder
description: Cancel an order and refund its amount. Only PLACED or PAID orders can be cancelled. Requires the mcp:tools:write scope and a token whose acr claim carries the step-up assurance level: a plain read-scoped or non-exchanged token is rejected before the order is ever looked up.

orderId.description: The order id, for example O-9001.

reason.description: Why the order is being cancelled, recorded for audit.
